verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say its PR review targets issues that matter rather than low-signal feedback. Findings are ranked by severity with why/how-to-fix explanations, and the review considers the full codebase rather than just the diff, which supports catching substantive defects. However, nothing documents detection of the specific bug classes in the story, and there is no hands-on validation of accuracy. One community user mentions switching to another bot, though without a concrete failure. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of detecting logic errors, race conditions and broken edge cases; independent or hands-on corroboration of bug-catching accuracy and false-positive rate.
